Founders Memo

Making data easier for everyone

When we started building Datavidhya, our vision was simple: Make data engineering accessible, practical, and career-defining.


In a world flooded with tools and theory-heavy content, we saw a gap, real-world, hands-on learning combined with strong community support. Data engineering isn’t just about pipelines and tools; it’s about solving real problems, building systems that scale, and enabling companies to make smarter decisions.


Let’s build the future of data, together.

Darshil Parmar

Founder, Datavidhya

All You Need to Know

Data Vidhya is a guided learning and interview-preparation platform for data careers. One subscription gives you 3 career tracks, 9 skill tracks, 28 courses, skill assessments and quizzes, 850+ coding problems, hands-on cloud labs, interactive data modeling and architecture playgrounds, 21 real-world projects, AI-powered interview tools, and a community of 25,000+ learners and engineers — all in one place.
Anyone looking to become a data engineer, analytics engineer, or data analyst; prepare for interviews; or upskill in tools like SQL, Python, Spark, dbt, Kafka, Airflow, and the cloud. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced engineer preparing for system design rounds, there's a structured path for you.
